assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: In bug-parsing.md, lines 50-52, the 'Environment / Version' section is parsed under 'Parsed Required Sections' with content: 'Not sure which version -- using whatever is deployed on staging.' The vague text is fully extracted.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, lines 9-23, sub-step 4.5.2 quotes the Environment / Version section content, scans for explicit version numbers, product-prefixed versions, and version keywords (finding none), and concludes: 'The section contains only vague text... No version pattern can be extracted.' Decision: 'Cannot extract a version identifier. Skipping to sub-step 4.5.6 (gap flagging).'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, lines 33-35, under '4.5.6 -- Flag Gap', the action states: 'Post a comment on ACME-511:' followed by the quoted comment 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description -- please set manually.' The message content matches the assertion (double-hyphen vs em-dash is a formatting variant of the same punctuation).

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, the gap comment text at line 35 is only: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description -- please set manually.' No Comment Footnote text is included in the comment body. Line 37 states 'Comment includes the Comment Footnote per skill requirements' but this is a claim, not actual inclusion. By contrast, root-cause.md lines 69-71 show what an actual Comment Footnote looks like ('This comment was AI-generated by [sdlc-workflow/triage-bug]...'), but no such footnote appears in the gap comment itself.
